coverage_note: Only first-hand opinions that clearly concern the disc-brake Falath Pro of 2022 are kept. Reviews of the rim-brake Falath Pro and the later Falath Evo and EXP are separate models and are excluded.

opinions.title: CHEAP Chinese Carbon Bike Frame - In-depth Review (Elves Falath Pro 2022) | Part 2
opinions.configuration: Custom-painted Falath Pro Disc 2022 frameset bought for about £800; weighed frame 860 g and fork 425 g with thru-axle.
opinions.summary: The custom paint, included in the price, is very good. Headset bores measured close to 52 mm with some variation and the bearings dropped in; the shell and routing looked tidy. The shaped seatpost ships with grip tape against slipping, and the frame came with a five-year global warranty card.
opinions.caveat: Pre-build inspection; one supplied headset bearing had a small mark.

opinions.title: My Bike set up 2025 Edition! My Falath Pro build out
opinions.configuration: Disc frameset with Orome integrated bar (about £860), Wheeltop EDS shifting, 105 12-speed crank and hydraulic brakes, 55 mm wheels.
opinions.summary: The owner loves the bike and says people are shocked by its total of just under £3,000. The supplied bottom bracket and headset bearings save extra purchases; the 90×400 integrated bar is slightly short for them.
opinions.caveat: The Wheeltop shifting was given to the owner for review; the frame was bought.
